scores.visual_critic_note: Colorblind-safe Tol palette, clear typographic hierarchy, and the swarm+boxplot pairing show deliberate design craft, but the top-earner callout lines tangle visually and the 'Sam Q.' label is clipped at the right SVG edge.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate and honest for income data, percentile lines and box plot are computed from actual data, dot size is uniform (no area encoding deception), but xScale domain is hardcoded [14000,550000] rather than derived from d3.extent, and no key functions for joins (acceptable for this static, no-update visualization).
scores.stress_test_note: Fully static bee swarm with pre-computed force simulation; no brush, zoom, transitions, or cross-view dispatch — only interaction is a lightweight pointermove tooltip (unified pointer events, trivial DOM cost), so none of the five interaction robustness traps apply.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single conceptual view with 4-color Tol palette, pre-computed static swarm, and a supplemental box plot — well within working memory limits; minor label crowding at percentile markers and top-earner callouts is the only friction.

proposer: Two changes: combined three axis-styling `.call()` chains into one, and merged the tooltip `pointerenter`+`pointermove` handlers into a single `pointermove` handler with chained style calls. Saves 5 lines (209 → 204).
